title: The normal locus of a Noetherian domain with a normal principal localization is open (Stacks 0332)
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is an integral domain, and suppose there is a nonzero $f\in R$ such that the localization $R_f$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Then the set $U=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}R:\ R_{\mathfrak p}\text{ is a normal domain}\}$, where $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is the localization at the prime $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], is open in $\operatorname{Spec}R$ for the Zariski topology [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
